title: SEBI chair: no decision yet on margin trading changes; longer market hours unlikely #Shorts
description:
SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said the regulator has not decided on proposals to revamp the Margin Trading Facility framework, and cited cybersecurity risks as a hurdle to extending market hours, as reported by NDTV Profit.

Sources: NDTV Profit
